name: Jasmine
source:
Jasmine is an amazonian martial arts instructor. She is very tall and tough. She doesn't talk very much and show even less emotion. 

She is one of the best in the country in her style (which one is never mentioned but her shorts has a "MMA" emblem), having become a national champion at 14 years old! She claims to have never lost a match (not unreasonable, a normal sized woman would surrender at least two foot to her) and stoped competing because it was no challenge any more. Her main regret is that she, when she won at 14, swore that she would give herself to the one that could defeat her, and that has never happened. She is thus still a virgin. 

She is friends with Sandra, the policewoman since their school years. Both of them were that extremely tall girl that no-one wanted to play with, and they found each other and bonded over that.
